statements: Worker success is not checker acceptance.
Checker CLEAN is not merge authority.
Unknown side-effect state is HELD, never green.
FounderGate will not retry an uncertain action until reconciliation is complete.

states.title: 1. Ready
states.detail: Setup pipeline PASS (25/25). Awaiting scheduling. Nothing dispatched.

states.title: 2. Builder running
states.detail: Governed worker dispatched under a single-use lease. Sealed intent recorded. NOT complete.

states.title: 3. Machine verification
states.detail: Builder exit-0 is NOT completion — mandatory machine verification in progress.

states.title: 4. Checker pending
states.detail: Independent read-only checker queued (distinct session + prompt). Worker success ≠ acceptance.

states.title: 5. Checker finding
states.detail: Checker returned findings → correction cycle. Not merged, not accepted.

states.title: 6. Needs reconciliation
states.detail: Dead process, no definitive result — HELD. FounderGate will NOT retry an uncertain action.

states.title: 7. Diagnostic branch
states.detail: dead process, no definitive result — do NOT re-fire; diagnostic branch only Diagnostic branch only — original transaction not re-fired.

states.title: 8. Abandoned
states.detail: Uncertain external effect could not be established — HELD, never green. Evidence preserved; other lanes continue.

states.title: 9. Deadline stopped
states.detail: Hard deadline reached. Scheduling halted. Running work torn down via process-tree teardown.

states.title: 10. Queue exhausted
states.detail: Auto-safe queue drained. Held/founder-gated/unknown jobs were NEVER auto-run.
